verdict.rationale: Unit is an API-first financial infrastructure platform, so scoped or least-privilege API credentials are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents token scopes, per-credential permissions, or agent-specific credentials. The sandbox evidence mentions only that the 'same auth scheme' applies, without describing any scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
